scaling: StandardScaler fit on each fold TRAIN only; cyclic features retained as sine/cosine and scaled identically

early_stopping.validation: last 15% of TRAIN dates, never rolling VALIDATION or TEST
early_stopping.inner_split: chronological by distinct dates; scaler fitted on inner fit subset only

seed_aggregation: mean predictions of all three fixed seeds; never select a seed
selection: lowest eligible-n-weighted mean rolling VALIDATION RMSE of fixed three-seed ensemble; ties within 1e-12 resolved by weighted fold RMSE SD, then fewer features, then fewer parameters, then lexicographic architecture
final_refit: all DEVELOPMENT 2004-2020; fixed per-seed epoch count is median best epoch across four development folds, rounded half up; no internal random early-stop split
test_access: only after frozen configuration, weights and their hashes
prospective: 2026+ reserved for future independent validation; excluded from v1
